title: Coding Is No Longer the Constraint
summary: Spotify describes how its background agent Honk, internal developer portal, standardized technology choices, and automated guardrails support large-scale agent work. Faster implementation shifted the bottleneck toward review and decisions, with the organization reporting substantially more pull requests to evaluate.
takeaway: Standardize repositories and expose ownership, documentation, and guardrails to agents before increasing autonomy; otherwise review becomes the new scaling failure.
